title: $Rg_*$ has a right adjoint for proper $g$
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category and $g\colon Z\to Y$ a proper morphism.
Then the derived pushforward

$$
Rg_*=R(g_*)\colon D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)
$$

(the right derived functor [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] of the pushforward of
[def-sfb-finite-lower-star]) has a right adjoint, denoted $Rg^!$.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the unconditional ambient pro-etale exceptional adjoint is false. For a positive dimensional abelian variety E over an algebraically closed field and field coefficients, ProEtale.not_preservesColimitsOfShape_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_isAbelianVariety proves that derived pushforward fails to preserve countable coproducts. A left adjoint would preserve them by the Mathlib adjunction-colimits instance. J2 independently checked the negation of the exact assigned conclusion, properness of E.hom, and every coefficient-category hypothesis at the original universe levels. The negation uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; the report reproduces the complete checked probe. To repair the return at head 25cc41b1950, this packet starts from the current adopted source, whose upstream sync removed the earlier dispute marker, and restores that marker with the checked counterexample. No signature, attribute, public import or proof body changes. No upstream-statement exception permits correcting or removing the assertion. The original hole remains; no positive proof, decomposition or pruning is claimed. The unit route and constructible exceptional inverse image are unchanged.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category and $g\colon Z\to Y$ a proper morphism.
Then the derived pushforward

$$
Rg_*=R(g_*)\colon D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)
$$

(the right derived functor [det-def-sfb-derived-categories] of the pushforward of
[def-sfb-finite-lower-star]) has a right adjoint, denoted $Rg^!$.

proof.text:
The derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category is well generated, and by Brown
representability (Neeman) a triangulated functor out of a well generated triangulated
category has a right adjoint as soon as it preserves arbitrary coproducts. $Rg_*$ is
triangulated, so it remains to show that it commutes with arbitrary direct sums. This is
where properness, more precisely quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of $g$, enters.
We have $(Rg_*K)(V)=R\Gamma(V\times_YZ,K)$, and on quasi-compact quasi-separated objects
of the pro-étale site cohomology commutes with filtered colimits of sheaves. This gives the
claim for bounded below complexes. The extension to unbounded complexes is the remaining
input.
